title: Dont deploy on arm64 compat, retry rclone if missing
body:
Fix issues on 2.0 branch.

### Don't [deploy](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/actions/runs/35940843565/job/107448357571#step:9:20) on arm64 compat

```bash
  assets=()
  if [[ "false" == "true" ]]; then
    zip -j libduckdb-src.zip \
      src/include/duckdb.h \
      src/include/duckdb_v2.h \
      src/include/duckdb_extension.h \
      src/include/duckdb_extension_v2.h
    assets+=(libduckdb-src.zip)
  fi
  if [[ "false" == "true" ]]; then
    make static-libs-release-artifact ARTIFACT_SUFFIX=linux-arm64 STATIC_LIBRARIES="build/release/src/libduckdb_static.a build/release/extension/*/lib*_extension.a"
    assets+=(duckdb-static-libs-linux-arm64.tar.gz)
  fi
  if [[ "false" == "true" ]]; then
    make cli-release-artifact ARTIFACT_SUFFIX=linux-arm64 CLI_BINARY=build/release/duckdb
    make shared-libs-release-artifact ARTIFACT_SUFFIX=linux-arm64 SHARED_LIBRARIES="build/release/src/libduckdb.so*"
    assets+=(duckdb-cli-linux-arm64.tar.gz duckdb-shared-libs-linux-arm64.tar.gz)
  fi
  ./scripts/upload-assets-to-staging.sh github_release "${assets[@]}"

Usage: ./scripts/upload-staging-asset.sh <folder> <file1> [... <fileN>]
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
```
